job.title: Project Manager
job.description:
Project Manager

Your Blueprint for Leadership in Construction

At Vee-Jay Cement Contracting Co., we don't just build structures; we craft legacies in concrete. Our work stands the test of time because of one key factor: excellent project management. As our new Project Manager, you will oversee projects that redefine city skylines and set industry benchmarks. With a company deeply rooted in the heart of construction innovation, your role is pivotal. Are you ready to lead and shape the future of concrete construction?

Performance Objectives

  • Lead and execute projects efficiently by adhering to timelines, costs, and quality standards, consistently achieving project objectives.
  • Develop comprehensive project plans, utilizing advanced planning tools, to ensure all stakeholders are synchronized and well-informed.
  • Facilitate regular and productive meetings with site teams, subcontractors, and stakeholders to align goals and solve challenges.
  • Implement safety protocols and regulatory standards, aiming for zero incidents across all project sites.
  • Enhance client satisfaction by nurturing strong relationships, fostering trust, and promptly addressing concerns or inquiries.
  • Drive profitability through strategic resource allocation and waste reduction, sustaining budget integrity.

Environment & Resources

  • Collaborate with a seasoned, multidisciplinary team dedicated to excellence and innovation.
  • Access to state-of-the-art project management tools that streamline processes and boost productivity.
  • Report directly to the Director of Operations, gaining insights from industry veterans.

Essential Qualifications

  • Proven track record of successful project delivery within the construction sector, with at least 5 years of experience.
  • Familiarity with advanced project management methodologies and software.
  • Strong leadership skills with an ability to influence and inspire teams and stakeholders.
  • In-depth understanding of construction safety, legal standards, and regulations.
  • Exceptional problem-solving capabilities and strategic thinking.

Role Selling Points

  • Join a company renowned for its commitment to advancing concrete construction technologies and techniques.
  • Influence projects that contribute significantly to the urban landscape and community development.
  • Competitive compensation with opportunities for career growth in a thriving industry.
  • Be part of an early-stage company where your contributions will have visible, long-term impact.

Take the Lead with Vee-Jay Cement

If you're ready to break new ground and excel in a dynamic environment, apply today and join us in creating a solid future in construction.

job.title: Quality Control Manager
job.description:
Quality Control Manager

Joining the County Prestress team means being part of a forward-thinking organization dedicated to setting the standard in construction and manufacturing excellence. As our Quality Control Manager, you play a pivotal role in ensuring our products' integrity, safety, and durability. Your work shapes not just our manufacturing processes but the future of construction industry standards.

Performance Objectives

  • Design and implement comprehensive quality control protocols to elevate product standards, achieving a 98% compliance rate across all manufacturing lines.
  • Lead a cross-functional team to identify inefficiencies and drive process improvements, reducing waste and rework by 20% within the first year.
  • Develop robust training programs for staff to enhance workmanship, resulting in a 30% decrease in on-site quality issues.
  • Conduct rigorous product testing and inspections, ensuring products meet client specifications and industry regulations.
  • Facilitate monthly quality audits and present actionable insights to elevate our product offerings and market competitiveness.

Environment & Resources

  • Collaborative team-based environment with direct reporting to the Director of Operations.
  • Access to cutting-edge technology and tools necessary to advance quality control initiatives.
  • Budgetary support for team training and professional development.

Essential Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Engineering or Quality Management.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in quality control management within the construction or manufacturing sector.
  • Exceptional analytical skills with proven track record in process optimization and problem-solving.
  • Strong leadership presence with the ability to inspire and motivate cross-functional teams.
  • Proficient in quality control methodologies and documentation processes.

Role Selling Points

  • Be part of a company at the forefront of innovation in the construction industry.
  • Opportunities for continuous professional growth and advancement.
  • Make a tangible impact on the safety and longevity of structures nationwide.
  • Excel in a role that combines strategic thinking with hands-on, practical outcomes.

Ready to build the future with County Prestress? Apply now and take the first step towards shaping the industry standards of tomorrow.

Visit us at countyprestress.com to learn more about our mission and the transformational roles we offer.

job.title: Quality Control Manager
job.description:
Quality Control Manager

Join County Prestress, a leader in innovative building solutions, and play a crucial role in ensuring the excellence of our construction materials. As our Quality Control Manager, you will drive quality initiatives that underpin every product we make—contributing to safer and more resilient infrastructures across the nation.

Performance Objectives

  • Develop and implement rigorous testing procedures to ensure all products meet industry standards and exceed client expectations.
  • Lead a dynamic team in conducting audits and inspections, identifying areas for improvement, and fostering a culture of continuous quality enhancement.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot and resolve quality issues swiftly, minimizing any operational disruptions.
  • Produce detailed quality reports and analyses to inform strategic decision-making and facilitate transparency with stakeholders.
  • Oversee compliance with federal and state safety regulations, ensuring all certification requirements are consistently achieved.
  • Drive innovation by recommending new tools and techniques to enhance quality control processes and efficiency.
  • Train and mentor team members, strengthening County Prestress’s commitment to professional development and quality excellence.

Environment & Resources

  • Lead a dedicated team of quality control inspectors
  • State-of-the-art testing laboratories and tools at your disposal
  • Report directly to the Director of Operations
  • Collaborate alongside a committed team of industry experts

Essential Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in quality control within the construction or manufacturing industry
  • Proven track record of implementing quality control processes that enhance product reliability and safety
  • In-depth knowledge of industry standards, safety regulations, and quality assurance practices
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire and develop teams
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field is preferred

Role Selling Points

  • Be at the forefront of an innovative, pioneering company dedicated to reshaping construction excellence
  • Opportunity to influence and shape product integrity in a privately-held, agile organization
  • Work in a nurturing environment that values employee growth and development

At County Prestress, your expertise and passion for quality will have a direct impact. If you're ready to drive the future of quality control in construction, apply now and help us build lasting legacies.

job.title: Quality Control Manager
job.description:
Quality Control Manager

Location: Nashville, Tennessee

Company: IMI

Job Summary

IMI is seeking an experienced Quality Control Manager to lead its Nashville Quality Control team and oversee quality performance across one of the region’s most active construction markets. This role combines hands-on ready-mix concrete expertise with people leadership, giving the successful candidate ownership of the QC function while serving as a trusted technical resource for customers, field teams, and internal operations.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned ready-mix Quality Control professional with deep technical knowledge, strong leadership capabilities, and the confidence to independently solve complex quality challenges. This is an excellent opportunity to lead and develop an established team, influence high-profile Nashville projects, and join an organization that provides its leaders with meaningful autonomy and decision-making authority.

Reporting Structure

Leads: Nashville Quality Control Team

Works Closely With:

  • Sales Management
  • Production Management
  • Regional Leadership
  • Engineers
  • Customers
  • Vendors
  • Field Personnel

The Quality Control Manager will be a key member of IMI’s Nashville leadership group, independently leading the QC function while collaborating closely with Sales and Production.

Key Responsibilities

Quality Control Leadership

  • Provide daily leadership, coaching, and mentorship to the Quality Control team.
  • Develop the technical and professional capabilities of current QC employees.
  • Take ownership of quality-related projects from initial review through resolution.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for customer and jobsite quality concerns.
  • Promote a proactive approach to quality by identifying potential issues before they escalate.

Technical Quality Management

  • Oversee concrete mix design development and troubleshooting.
  • Monitor concrete performance and ensure compliance with project specifications and quality standards.
  • Provide hands-on technical support to field personnel.
  • Manage quality across commercial and residential ready-mix projects.
  • Oversee approximately 5–10 primary projects or quality issues each day.
  • Troubleshoot complex concrete, jobsite, and customer quality challenges.

Customer & Operational Support

  • Resolve customer quality concerns associated with active projects.
  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Production, Operations, engineers, customers, and vendors.
  • Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Maintain high quality standards throughout IMI’s Nashville-area operations.

Qualifications

Required / Important

  • Significant Quality Control experience within the ready-mix concrete industry.
  • Strong technical knowledge of ready-mix concrete and quality control practices.
  • Experience managing concrete quality across multiple active projects.
  • Concrete mix design development and troubleshooting experience.
  • Knowledge of cement fundamentals and concrete performance.
  • Experience with concrete testing and specification requirements.
  • Strong jobsite and field troubleshooting capabilities.
  • Appropriate DOT-related knowledge or certification based on IMI’s project requirements.

Preferred

  • Previous people management or team leadership experience.
  • Experience mentoring and developing Quality Control professionals.
  • CIM degree or Concrete Industry Management background.
  • Formal concrete or construction-related education.
  • Experience managing technically demanding construction projects.

Key Competencies

  • Ready-mix concrete Quality Control
  • Concrete mix design development
  • Mix troubleshooting
  • Concrete performance analysis
  • Technical problem-solving
  • Quality planning
  • Customer issue resolution
  • Project ownership
  • Team leadership and mentorship
  • Proactive risk identification
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Field and production support
  • Management of multiple active projects

Leadership & Personal Style

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

  • Strong leadership presence and accountability.
  • Ability to coach, mentor, and develop others.
  • Proactive rather than reactive problem-solving.
  • Clear and confident communication.
  • Independent decision-making.
  • Collaborative management style.
  • Strong customer-facing skills.
  • Composure under pressure.
  • Willingness to take ownership of difficult issues.
  • Ability to operate successfully without micromanagement.

Location & Travel

  • Based in Nashville, Tennessee, with the primary office located on Haywood Lane.
  • Territory includes Nashville and surrounding markets, extending north toward Clarksville and generally covering areas west of I-65.
  • Minimal travel, primarily consisting of local and regional customer or project visits.
  • Nashville-based presence is expected.
  • Relocation assistance is available for qualified candidates.
  • Some work-from-home flexibility may be available when appropriate.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: Open and flexible based on the experience of the successful candidate.
  • Full benefits package
  • Company vehicle
  • Company laptop
  • Relocation assistance for qualified candidates

job.title: Superintendent
job.description:
Civil Construction Superintendent

Locations: San Diego and Long Beach / Los Angeles, California

Company: JMH

Job Summary

JMH is seeking experienced Civil Construction Superintendents to provide field leadership across complex civil and infrastructure projects throughout California. With two openings available, one position will primarily support projects in the San Diego market, while the second will be based around Long Beach / Los Angeles with responsibility for projects that may extend throughout California.

This role is responsible for maintaining a high-level view across multiple active projects while coordinating field teams, equipment, subcontractors, schedules, safety, quality, and customer expectations. The ideal candidate is a proven heavy civil leader with experience across earthwork, grading, underground utilities, concrete, asphalt, roadway, and site infrastructure who can effectively delegate, mentor field leaders, and take ownership of project performance.

Reporting Structure

Works Closely With:

  • Project Managers
  • Foremen
  • Field Crews
  • Subcontractors
  • Suppliers
  • Inspectors
  • Customers

The Superintendent may oversee resources across as many as five active projects while coordinating manpower and equipment and providing leadership and mentorship to Foremen.

Key Responsibilities

Field Operations & Project Execution

  • Oversee multiple active civil construction projects while maintaining visibility into schedule, budget, safety, quality, and project dependencies.
  • Manage civil scopes including earthwork, grading, underground utilities, concrete, asphalt, paving, roadway, and site infrastructure.
  • Coordinate Project Managers, Foremen, field crews, subcontractors, suppliers, and customers.
  • Allocate labor, equipment, and resources across multiple projects.
  • Coordinate material deliveries, inspections, survey activities, testing, and project sequencing.

Planning & Scheduling

  • Develop and maintain master schedules, project milestones, and two-week look-ahead plans.
  • Track production quantities, man-hours, equipment utilization, and overall job progress.
  • Identify potential schedule conflicts and project risks before they impact performance.
  • Develop and implement recovery plans when projects fall behind schedule.
  • Coordinate upcoming project phases to ensure crews, equipment, and materials are prepared.

Project & Field Management

  • Review civil plans, specifications, permits, contracts, RFIs, submittals, and change orders.
  • Maintain accurate field documentation and support project closeout requirements.
  • Monitor field performance while minimizing downtime and avoidable rework.
  • Maintain strong customer relationships through site walks, progress meetings, and proactive communication.
  • Support punch-list completion and successful project closeout.

Leadership & Safety

  • Mentor and develop Foremen and other field leaders.
  • Foster a culture of teamwork, accountability, and mutual respect.
  • Reinforce company safety expectations and project-specific safety plans.
  • Delegate effectively while maintaining accountability for project results.
  • Serve as a trusted field leader for employees, customers, and project stakeholders.

Qualifications

Industry Experience

  • Previous Superintendent-level experience or substantial senior field leadership experience within civil construction.
  • Strong heavy civil construction background.
  • Experience overseeing multiple projects, crews, equipment, and subcontractors.

Preferred Project Experience

  • Earthwork and grading
  • Underground utilities
  • Roadway and site development
  • Concrete and asphalt construction
  • Public works and infrastructure
  • Survey coordination
  • Traffic control and public safety
  • Environmental and erosion-control requirements
  • Multi-project field supervision
  • Change-order and field documentation management

Education & Certifications

Formal education requirements were not specified. Preferred certifications may include:

  • OSHA safety training
  • Civil construction or heavy-equipment certifications
  • First Aid / CPR
  • Competent Person training
  • Underground utility, excavation, or traffic-control certifications

Key Competencies

  • Civil construction field leadership
  • Multi-project oversight
  • Earthwork and heavy-equipment production
  • Underground utility coordination
  • Two-week look-ahead planning
  • Manpower and equipment allocation
  • Civil plan and specification interpretation
  • Change-order management
  • Job-cost and man-hour awareness
  • RFIs, submittals, inspections, and as-built documentation
  • Quality control and field issue resolution
  • Customer and subcontractor communication
  • Procore or comparable construction management systems

Behavioral Characteristics

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

  • Strong and professional field leadership.
  • Clear and consistent communication.
  • Strong problem-solving ability.
  • Collaboration and teamwork.
  • Integrity and accountability.
  • Confidence delegating without micromanaging.
  • Ability to coach and develop Foremen.
  • Calm decision-making in fast-moving environments.
  • Adaptability and willingness to ask for support when needed.
  • Respectful, customer-focused communication.

Location & Travel

San Diego Position

  • Primarily supports projects throughout the San Diego area.
  • Strong onsite presence required.
  • Limited overnight travel anticipated depending on project needs.

Long Beach / Los Angeles Position

  • Based around Long Beach or the greater Los Angeles area.
  • May oversee projects extending from San Diego through the San Francisco region.
  • Must be comfortable managing a broad California territory and traveling based on project demands.

Both positions are field-based and require regular onsite presence.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Discretionary bonus opportunity
  • Company vehicle or vehicle allowance
  • Gas card
  • Company cell phone
  • Insurance benefits
  • Additional benefits available based on company programs

job.title: Sales Representative
job.description:
Job Description

The County Materials Family of Companies manufactures and delivers concrete construction products to meet the demand for growing communities. Since 1946, we've relied on our talented and dedicated team members to provide reliable products with personalized service. 

 

We’re hiring a Sales Representative to join County Materials in Oconomowoc, WI.

 

Job Summary:

Sales Representatives engage contractors and customers to strengthen the company’s position within the markets it serves. This role is responsible for maintaining and growing existing customer accounts, building long-term relationships, developing new business opportunities, and driving sales of designated products.

 

Job Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Maintain strong, effective relationships with existing customers to drive increased sales and revenue
  • Identify, prospect, and develop new customer opportunities, accurately document activities in CRM systems
  • Collaborate with customers and contractors to develop sales strategies, specifications, and project opportunities
  • Support local, regional, and national sales and promotional initiatives
  • Analyze market trends and customer needs to identify opportunities and develop action plans
  • Drive sales of assigned product lines in alignment with company objectives
  • Prepare and present sales project updates, forecasting, and prospecting activity for regular review meetings
  • Serve as a professional representative of the company at customer sites, job sites, and industry-related activities
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

COUNTY Core Competencies: The expected behaviors of all COUNTY team members that align with Our Values and Our Commitments:

  • Integrity & Organizational Awareness 
  • Customer First Focus 
  • Results Driven Orientation 
  • Teamwork, Safety & Collaboration 
  • Problem Solving & Decision Making 
  • Creativity & Innovation 

Job-Based Competencies:

  • Business and Industry Analysis 
  • Product Analysis 
  • Overarching Sales Delivery 
  • Demand Generation 
  • Developing Leads into Sales & Growing Accounts 

 

Experience & Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent combination of education, training, and work experience
  • Previous sales experience preferred; experience in construction, building materials, or related industries is a plus
  • Knowledge of masonry, concrete, hardscape, or similar product lines preferred
  • Familiarity with industry specifications and standards (e.g., ASTM) preferred
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and experience using CRM systems; ability to work with numerical and sales data.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem‑solving skills
  • Self‑motivated, results‑driven, and able to work independently
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Valid driver’s license with a satisfactory driving record

 

Work Environment:

  • Combination of office-based work, customer visits, and construction site visits
  • Exposure to outdoor environments and varying weather conditions
  • Travel required: typically regional, within the state of assigned territory.
  • Typical work schedule: This role routinely operates outside a traditional Monday–Friday daytime schedule. Evenings, weekends, and overnight travel are frequently required to support customer events, relationship‑building activities, and industry trade shows.

 

Physical & Work Expectations:

An individual in this position must be able to successfully perform the essential duties and responsibilities listed above. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

  • Ability to handle samples and products up to 50 pounds.
  • Frequent standing, walking, bending, reaching, or handling materials/equipment.
  • Occasional climbing, kneeling, crawling, or lifting/moving up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to concentrate, follow detailed instructions, communicate effectively, and safely perform job duties.

 

 

 

The County Materials Family of Companies connects candidates with rewarding careers in concrete manufacturing, an industry that’s growing faster than most. We work alongside individuals to leverage their skills and align them with diverse job opportunities in production, transportation, safety, finance, human resources, information technology, marketing, risk management, and more. 

 

Military service members and veterans are encouraged to apply.  

 

Benefits Overview: 

Central Processing Corporation is the payroll and benefit service of the County Materials Family of Companies. 

  • Health, dental and vision insurance
  • Paid Short-term & Long-term disability
  • 401(k) match
  • 8 Paid holidays
  • Paid Time Off
  • Referral rewards program
  • Wellness program with rewards
  • Flexible Savings Options
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Paid Life Insurance
  • $200 Boot Allowance
  • Safety focused: GUARD for Life
  • Voluntary critical illness & accident insurance
  • Optional Uniform Program

job.title: Sales Engineer
job.description:
Regional Sales Engineer

Location: Home-Based (Preferred near Chicago, Indianapolis, Columbus, OH, or Detroit)

Company: Bekaert

Job Summary

Bekaert is seeking a Regional Sales Engineer to expand the adoption of its innovative steel and synthetic fiber reinforcement solutions throughout the Midwest. This position combines technical engineering expertise with consultative sales, partnering with structural engineers, consultants, and decision-makers to influence project specifications early in the design process.

The ideal candidate has a Civil or Structural Engineering background, enjoys building long-term relationships, and is passionate about helping customers solve complex engineering challenges. This is an exciting opportunity to join a global leader in reinforcement technology while developing a rewarding career in technical sales and business development.

Reporting Structure

Reports To: Bradley Smith

Direct Reports: None

Works Closely With:

  • Technical Support Team
  • Engineering Team
  • Commercial Sales Team
  • Global Product Specialists

Key Responsibilities

Technical Sales & Business Development

  • Develop relationships with structural engineers, consultants, contractors, and key project stakeholders.
  • Drive specification and adoption of Bekaert's steel and synthetic fiber reinforcement products.
  • Identify new business opportunities while growing existing customer relationships.
  • Expand market share throughout the assigned Midwest territory.

Engineering & Customer Support

  • Educate engineers, architects, and customers on product applications and technical advantages.
  • Serve as a trusted technical resource throughout the design and specification process.
  • Deliver technical presentations to engineering firms, customers, and industry organizations.
  • Partner with internal engineering and technical teams to develop customer-focused solutions.

Territory Management

  • Independently manage a multi-state sales territory.
  • Travel approximately 40%, primarily every other week.
  • Build strategic relationships with engineering firms and industry influencers.
  • Represent Bekaert at ACI chapter meetings, technical seminars, and industry events.

Qualifications

Industry Experience

  • 3–7 years of professional experience.
  • Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Experience with reinforced concrete systems preferred.
  • Technical sales or business development experience is a plus.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to communicate complex engineering concepts to a variety of audiences.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to build and grow a territory.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Engineering-related certifications.
  • Experience participating in ACI chapters or other industry organizations.
  • Exposure to steel fiber or synthetic fiber reinforcement products is a plus.

Key Competencies

  • Civil and structural engineering expertise
  • Consultative selling
  • Technical presentations
  • Business development
  • Territory management
  • Customer relationship management
  • Communication and presentation skills
  • Problem-solving and technical support

Behavioral Characteristics

  • Self-motivated and entrepreneurial
  • Strong relationship builder
  • Collaborative team player
  • Excellent communicator
  • Adaptable and results-oriented
  • Professional presence
  • High energy with a passion for continuous learning

Travel & Work Environment

  • Home-based position within the Midwest territory.
  • Preferred home base near Chicago, Indianapolis, Columbus (OH), or Detroit, with proximity to a major airport.
  • Approximately 40% travel, generally every other week, with flexibility to manage your own travel schedule.

Compensation & Benefits

  • 20% Annual Bonus
  • Company vehicle or vehicle allowance
  • Comprehensive healthcare package
  • Three weeks of vacation
  • Floating holidays
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Excellent parental leave benefits

Why Join Bekaert?

  • Join one of the world's leading companies in reinforcement technology, operating in more than 80 countries.
  • Work alongside industry experts with the support of global engineering and product specialists.
  • Influence how reinforced concrete projects are designed and specified across the Midwest.
  • Enjoy a collaborative culture focused on innovation, continuous learning, technical excellence, and career development while maintaining the autonomy to manage your own territory.

job.title: General Manager
job.description:
General Manager

Location: Roberts, Wisconsin (Greater Minneapolis–St. Paul Metro Area)

Company: County Materials

Job Summary

County Materials is seeking a General Manager to lead its Roberts, Wisconsin facility and drive the continued success of one of its key business units. This leadership role carries full profit and loss responsibility while overseeing both sales and operations, ensuring the facility delivers exceptional customer service, operational excellence, and sustainable business growth.

The ideal candidate is a proven leader with a strong background in sales, business development, and operational leadership within the construction materials industry. This is an outstanding opportunity to take ownership of an established operation, lead a high-performing team, and play a key role in the company's long-term growth strategy.

Reporting Structure

Reports To: Bryan Rempt

Direct Reports:

  • Plant Operations Manager
  • Two Outside Sales Representatives
  • Sales Operations Manager

Works Closely With:

  • Executive Leadership
  • Operations Leadership
  • Sales Team
  • Plant Leadership

Key Responsibilities

Business Leadership & Strategy

  • Assume full P&L responsibility for the Roberts facility.
  • Develop and execute strategies that drive revenue growth, profitability, and operational excellence.
  • Identify new market opportunities and expand customer relationships throughout the region.
  • Lead long-term business planning while supporting company growth initiatives.

Sales & Market Development

  • Lead and develop the facility's sales organization.
  • Drive business development and increase market presence.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, distributors, and industry partners.
  • Support strategic account growth and customer retention initiatives.

Operations & Team Leadership

  • Partner closely with the Plant Operations Manager to optimize plant performance.
  • Lead cross-functional teams while fostering a collaborative, high-performance culture.
  • Coach, mentor, and develop employees across sales and operations.

  • Monitor key performance indicators and implement strategies to improve results.
  • Ensure efficient coordination between sales, operations, and executive leadership.
  • Maintain a strong focus on safety, quality, and customer satisfaction.

Qualifications

Industry Experience

  • Proven leadership experience within construction materials, precast concrete, concrete pipe, aggregates, or a related industry.
  • Previous P&L ownership and business unit leadership experience.
  • Strong background in sales leadership and business development.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams in manufacturing or construction environments.
  • Candidates with a Sales Manager background who have demonstrated leadership potential are strongly encouraged to apply.

Education & Qualifications

  • No formal education requirement.
  • Strong business and financial acumen required.
  • Experience with structured sales methodologies (such as Sandler) is a plus.

Key Competencies

  • P&L management and financial accountability
  • Sales leadership and business development
  • Strategic planning and execution
  • Customer relationship management
  • Operational leadership
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Team development and coaching
  • Market expansion and growth strategy
  • Problem-solving and decision-making

Behavioral Characteristics

  • Collaborative leadership style
  • Strong communicator with excellent interpersonal skills
  • High emotional intelligence
  • Team-first mindset
  • Adaptable and solutions-oriented
  • Accountable with strong integrity
  • Effective decision-maker and relationship builder

Work Environment & Travel

  • Based in Roberts, Wisconsin, serving the greater Minneapolis–St. Paul market.
  • Fully on-site leadership position.
  • Open to nationwide relocation, with relocation assistance available for qualified candidates.
  • Strong consideration given to candidates with ties to Wisconsin, Minnesota, Iowa, or the Upper Midwest.

Compensation & Benefits

  • 20% Annual Performance Bonus
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • Relocation assistance available for qualified candidates

Why Join County Materials?

  • Lead an established, high-performing facility with significant autonomy and influence.
  • Join a financially stable organization with a long-standing reputation in the construction materials industry.
  • Work alongside an approachable executive leadership team that continually invests in its people and operations.
  • Enjoy a collaborative, team-first culture focused on growth, innovation, and operational excellence.
  • Play a key role in driving the future success of a respected industry leader while making a lasting impact on the business.

job.title: Senior Project Manager
job.description:
Project Manager – Senior

Location: Sterling, Virginia (Occasional Project Travel)

Company: Freyssinet

Job Summary

Freyssinet is seeking a high-potential Project Manager to lead complex specialty construction projects while preparing for future operations leadership. This role is designed for an experienced Project Manager who is ready to take the next step in their career by managing challenging projects, mentoring fellow Project Managers, and helping drive operational excellence across the organization.

Rather than seeking someone who already holds a Senior Project Manager title, Freyssinet is looking for a proven construction leader with a strong upward career trajectory, exceptional financial and project management skills, and the ambition to grow into a Senior Project Manager, Operations Manager, or Regional Operations Leadership role. This is a unique opportunity to join a global leader in specialty infrastructure construction with a clear path for long-term advancement.

Reporting Structure

Reports To: Operations Leadership

Works Closely With:

  • Superintendents
  • Project Managers
  • Project Engineers
  • Executive Leadership

Key Responsibilities

Project Leadership & Execution

  • Lead multiple complex specialty construction projects from award through completion.
  • Develop project execution plans, schedules, and resource allocation strategies.
  • Manage project budgets, forecasting, cost controls, and overall financial performance.
  • Review contracts, drawings, specifications, and project documentation.
  • Oversee procurement, subcontractor coordination, and project planning activities.

Leadership & Operational Development

  • Mentor and support Project Managers and project teams.
  • Identify opportunities to improve project execution, operational processes, and team performance.
  • Build strong relationships with clients, field leadership, and internal stakeholders.
  • Contribute to strategic operational initiatives while preparing for future leadership responsibilities.
  • Promote collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement throughout project execution.

Financial & Client Management

  • Maintain project profitability through proactive forecasting and risk management.
  • Manage client relationships from project kickoff through closeout.
  • Identify and resolve project challenges before they impact schedule or budget.
  • Ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently, and in accordance with company quality standards.

Qualifications

Industry Experience

  • 10–15 years of progressive construction experience with increasing leadership responsibilities.
  • Experience in commercial construction, heavy civil, structural concrete, specialty contracting, or infrastructure projects.
  • Self-performed construction experience preferred.
  • Bridge rehabilitation or concrete restoration experience is beneficial but not required.
  • Current experience as a Project Manager, Lead Project Manager, Construction Manager, or Senior Project Engineer ready for advancement.

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, or a related field preferred.
  • Equivalent construction management experience will be considered.
  • OSHA certification preferred.
  • Post-tensioning experience is a plus but not required.

Key Competencies

  • Project planning and execution
  • Budget development and financial management
  • Cost forecasting and project controls
  • Scheduling and resource planning
  • Contract administration
  • Procurement and vendor management
  • Client relationship management
  • Risk management and problem-solving
  • Leadership development and mentoring
  • Continuous process improvement

Behavioral Characteristics

  • Strategic thinker with strong organizational skills
  • Collaborative leadership style
  • Excellent communicator and relationship builder
  • Financially disciplined
  • Adaptable and solution-oriented
  • Calm under pressure

job.title: BIM Modeler
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Create / produce information models related to project definition or updates during the construction phase.
  • Update information models to reflect changes occurring in the asset during the operational phase.
  • Develop information models according to the BIM uses requested by the appointing party. 
  • Prepare BIM models for coordination with other stakeholders, following the guidelines of the project’s BIM coordinators 

and client requirements.

  • Resolve assigned clashes and coordination issues.
  • Report coordination issues for further review. (RFI) 
  • Prepare documentation required to meet deliverables related to both development and operational phase processes.

(Panel Book & Panel Layout)

  • Develop and maintain both graphical and non-graphical models in accordance with the project standards. 
  • Prepare information models for sharing with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Produce project outputs derived from graphical and non-graphical models. 
  • Review outputs to address clashes: maintain ongoing communication with the BIM Coordinator and participate in BIM 

coordination and technology meetings.

  • Reference other shared models to ensure design coordination and avoid conflicts.
  • Comply with modeling standards and conventions defined in the BIM Execution Plan (BEP), including naming, coding, and 

data structure requirements.

  • Use Common Data Environments (CDE) to upload, extract, and coordinate information, following established protocols. 
  • Maintain up-to-date records of model revisions and versions, ensuring traceability of changes. 
  • Apply quality reviews and technical validation before sharing models with other disciplines. 
  • Coordinate with the Discipline Lead or Project Manager to align model development with the overall schedule and delivery 

milestones.

  • Support the generation of both graphical and non-graphical documentation (drawings, reports, quantity take-offs, etc.) 

derived from the model, in agreed formats.

  • Participate in training, feedback sessions, or continuous improvement initiatives related to BIM processes within the team. 

Key Competencies

Operational Set


  • General Modeling: Use of computer tools to model project requirements and generate

Model-based deliverables across sectors, information systems, and domains of knowledge 

  • Capture and Representation: Use of computer tools and special equipment to capture and represent spaces and environments 

from architectural and structural PDF drawings, including the creation and development of parametric families in Revit.

  • Linking and Extension: Linking BIM Models and their components with other databases.
  • Automation and Scripting: Use of tools such as Dynamo, Grasshopper, or Python scripts to automate repetitive tasks and 

increase productivity in modeling or data management.

  • Custom Modeling: Use of software tools to provide a customized combination of Model-based deliverables that reflect 

a variety of Model Uses.


Technical Set


  • Modeling: Generation of BIM models based on predefined modeling standards and protocols. 
  • Documentation: Generation of construction drawings and documents using standardized details and workflows.
  • Model Management: Management and maintenance of BIM models generated using standardized processes, 

protocols, and specifications.

  • Document Management: Use of document management systems or similar tools to store, manage, and share BIM files and models

job.title: Structural Engineer
job.description:
Structural Engineer 

Location: Greenville, SC 

Relocation assistance available 

• This position is responsible for the cost-efficient design of precast concrete systems, connections, 

and components. Reviews and approves drawings developed from designs. Coordinates with 

drafter/modelers, coordinators, and other engineers when applicable to facilitate successful 

completion of projects. 

RESPONSIBILITIES 

• Perform engineering calculations and details for all products and connections. 

• Independently manage engineering design aspects of a project with minimal assistance or 

guidance. 

• Review contract documents to be familiar with project requirements. 

• Attend project meetings; may lead coordination meetings. 

• Write and review requests for information (RFI). 

• Resolve engineering design issues independently. 

• Assist others with resolving engineering design issues. 

• Check engineering design calculations and details of others – including external 

consultants/subcontractors - for accuracy, efficiency and Engineering Design Process. 

• Review erection drawings, master shop tickets, and any additional shop tickets to ensure designs 

and standards are followed. 

• Be actively aware of production processes through regular plant visits. 

• Become licensed in states where engineering work is performed and, when assigned, review and 

stamp erection drawings, calculations, and repair details. 

• Evaluate design cost as compared to estimate and take appropriate action. 

• Complete repairs without assistance.

Position Requirements 

• 3-7 years of relevant engineering experience – internal or external 

• Previous precast knowledge preferred 

• Highly dependable with strong work ethic 

• Eager to learn 

• Able to work individually or on a team 

• Strongly values relationships and interaction with people 

• Maintains a balanced perspective about change; adapts when necessary while placing value in 

consistency of processes 

• Positive outlook 

• Computer skills (experience with engineering design software preferred) 

• Analytical thinker with above average problem-solving skills 

• Attention to detail and accuracy 

• Strong personal organization skills 

• Above average ability to manage multiple priorities 

• Self-motivated 

• Values teaching and demonstrates a willingness to develop others 

• Demonstrated ability to managed multiple projects and priorities, maintain project schedules, and 

work effectively within a project team 

• Above average assertiveness; proactively addresses project issues 

• Strong communication skills 

• Able to document ongoing information on projects for record keeping purposes 

• Able to adapt to changes in work schedules, tasks, or processes

REQUIREMENTS:

How do we take care of you?

day of employment
